# Staging

Read the project target/requirements and campaign recipe. Freeze actual sequences,
constructs, chemistry, chain roles/copies, hotspot definitions and source hashes.
Preserve numbering maps and assay-versus-model construct differences explicitly.
Prepare under project drafts/; create a new immutable run when settings or inputs
change. Record parent run IDs and selected source artifacts. No engine defaults
or inferred topology. Input freezing is not native scientific validation.

Deliverable: frozen payload and settings plus exact pin/input hashes. Before
execution, validate the chosen engine's native input against the intended molecule.
